Manage the persistent background daemon

Start, stop, and check status of the persistent background daemon that manages the continuous task pipeline. The daemon runs as a detached process with a WebSocket server for CLI/TUI communication.

Aliases: `dm`

```sh
woco daemon <subcommand> [flags]
```

Read-only.

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
